source: Native GitHub issue dependencies, verified in both blocked_by and blocking directions. Parent/sub-issue links define scope only and never create edges.

nodes.title: Expose ContentAddressV1 identity inputs to Edict source
nodes.summary: Expose the exact ContentAddressV1 law to authored source, with independent vectors and public execution evidence.

nodes.title: Authored reads: typed outgoing-edge reads and a guided bounded closure read
nodes.summary: Read typed outgoing edges and a bounded, witnessed closure while preserving distinct root/path occurrences.

nodes.title: Slice: Author and prove Jim's first Edict operation ReplaceRange
nodes.summary: Prove the complete authored ReplaceRange operation through public compilation, separate verification and generic Echo execution, discharging all 40 retained obligations.

nodes.title: Add bounded list operations needed by explicit worklists
nodes.summary: Authored code can measure, select from, and build bounded list worklists with typed outcomes and checked static costs.

nodes.title: Publish and prove bounded list values through the public provider path
nodes.summary: Compiler-produced bounded list values are independently verified and executed by the published generic Echo provider, including the ordered-read route.

nodes.title: Collections: specify places, ownership, snapshots, and candidate laws
nodes.summary: A versioned collections contract and a small executable reference model make the proposed semantics testable before a production representation is selected.

nodes.title: Refresh the authored-rope capability matrix against exact public artifacts
nodes.summary: A reproducible source-to-provider inventory identifies the remaining concrete blockers for the real iterative rope program and its exact current component tuple.

nodes.title: Define typed immutable content references and semantic value identity
nodes.summary: Authored immutable values have a portable semantic digest, bounded typed resolution and normalized ensure obligations distinct from target storage IDs.

nodes.title: Execute and publish bounded list worklist operations
nodes.summary: The list operations emitted by Amblicit execute through the separate provider verifier and generic evaluator with matching bounds and charges.

nodes.title: Demonstrate a pure optic description on the existing flat text operation
nodes.summary: One bounded payload-focus description can explain and lower the existing flat operation without adding reads or authority.

nodes.title: Compile one witnessed optional-slot optic and guarded candidate
nodes.summary: The compiler represents an optional membership observation and a bounded proposed slot change under the versioned collection law.

nodes.title: Execute and publish structured bounded effect loops and branches
nodes.summary: Generic Echo executes compiler-produced structured Target IR loops and conditional effects in the declared order.

nodes.title: Define executable schema-2 fixtures for every retained rope obligation
nodes.summary: All 40 retained oracle IDs have independently specified schema-2 fixtures, typed outcomes and physical expectations, including explicit decisions for all 12 counterparts.

nodes.title: Execute witnessed optional-slot observations and guarded changes
nodes.summary: The first optional-slot optic runs through public source, independent verification and Echo atomic admission with complete dynamic support.

nodes.title: Compile bounded snapshot traversal with complete selection support
nodes.summary: Authored traversal yields authoritative entries from one basis and retains the support of empty and filtered observations.

nodes.title: Compile collection membership operations into one validated candidate
nodes.summary: Authors can express get/add/remove/replace/iter under one fixed basis while the compiler preserves payload, ownership and candidate obligations.

nodes.title: Execute bounded collection traversal and preserve negative reads
nodes.summary: Published Echo execution corroborates the complete snapshot traversal contract, including empty and filtered read support.

nodes.title: Admit collection candidates atomically with ownership and capacity
nodes.summary: One public collection operation validates and commits its complete candidate, or retains a typed outcome without partial application mutation.

nodes.title: Enforce immutable content resolution and ensure candidates
nodes.summary: Echo realizes the portable content contract with typed bounded resolution, target identity checks and immutable admitted storage.

nodes.title: Compose the demonstrated optics without losing basis or support
nodes.summary: The proven payload, membership, traversal and content foci compose within an explicitly bounded subset without inventing authority or dropping context.

nodes.title: Prove authored ReplaceRange through the collections and optics surface
nodes.summary: The completed authored rope operation uses the new supported collection/content/optic authoring surface while preserving all text, physical and causal acceptance obligations.

nodes.title: Retire raw CreateNode from new authored surfaces while preserving replay
nodes.summary: New authoring profiles require the proven collection/content contracts; retained historical artifacts keep an explicit tested replay path.
